_about: What is on the ship. The AI doctor may ONLY suggest items from this list, at the label dose, and must check allergies. Fictional, simplified.

medicines.name: Paracetamol (acetaminophen) 500 mg
medicines.labelDose: 1–2 tablets every 4–6 h, max 8 tablets (4 g) in 24 h

medicines.name: Ibuprofen 200 mg
medicines.labelDose: 1–2 tablets every 6–8 h with food, max 6 tablets (1.2 g) in 24 h without a doctor
medicines.caution: Avoid if dehydrated or kidney problems suspected; take with water

medicines.name: Oral rehydration salts
medicines.labelDose: 1 sachet in 200 mL water, after each loose stool or as needed

medicines.name: Promethazine 25 mg
medicines.labelDose: Only after talking to the crew medical officer (causes drowsiness)

medicines.name: Azithromycin 250 mg
medicines.labelDose: Only on instruction from the crew medical officer or flight surgeon
